definitions.centroid: Mean positive-pixel indices, x column/y row, zero-based 256x256 coordinates
definitions.defect_types: All owner comma-separated labels as JSON; combined source label retained; no dominant class
definitions.distribution_quantiles: Linear interpolation; standard deviation sample ddof=1
definitions.peak_tie: First maximum in NumPy C row-major order; peak_tie_count also saved
definitions.pixel_geometry: Original Run1 256x256 maps and nearest-resized masks; area and centroids at that geometry
definitions.roc: All distinct strict > operating points, plus threshold nextafter(minimum,-inf). At each target select maximum attainable recall within FPR budget; ties prefer lowest FPR then highest threshold. Retrospective diagnostic thresholds only.
definitions.score: Saved primary_score; raw unnormalized anomaly map
definitions.size_quartiles: Higher empirical q25/q50/q75; equal-area ties all assigned lower boundary group; possible empty groups retained
definitions.threshold: Original frozen image/pixel thresholds; strict score > threshold; ties normal
definitions.type_count: Each image once per annotated type; multi-label images contribute to multiple groups, so counts need not sum to100. Scores/localization evaluate union mask, not type-specific masks.

role: Retrospective PCB1 development diagnosis; no inference/refitting or confirmatory claim
